description:
Measure the validation views and the side paths on a copy of this repository with a release build, and record the run as evidence for the per-issue bound.

## Background

- `scripts/benchmark-mutation-cost.sh` builds fixture copies of this repository (`git clone --shared` plus `.jit` sync), waits until the 1-minute load average is below `BENCH_MAX_LOAD` (default 2.0, polled for at most 30 minutes, `:16-17,216-222`), and times commands as the median of three runs; its committed run is `dev/benchmarks/publication-cost-722878d4/`.
- Before this work, `jit validate <id>` took about three times as long as whole-repository `jit validate` on this repository (`dev/active/9876a23a-one-validation-report/investigation.md`, capture part, REQ-08 row). After it, per-issue validation does a subset of whole validation's work, so the expected margin is small and host load during multi-agent work is high.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The harness, generalised in `scripts/benchmark-mutation-cost.sh`, times `jit validate` and `jit validate <id>` in at least five interleaved pairs (one of each per pair, alternating which runs first) on a fresh copy of this repository with a release binary, records the load threshold it applied and the load before and after, and times `jit validate --scope <container>`, `jit validate <id> --explain`, `jit issue create` (human, `--json`, `--quiet`) and `jit validate --fix --dry-run` as medians of at least five runs.
- [hard] REQ-02: `dev/active/9876a23a-one-validation-report/benchmark/README.md` records one run with the commit, the binary, the fixture's issue count, the load threshold and loads, every median, each pair's difference (per-issue minus whole) with their median and spread, and the raw timings beside it.
- [hard] REQ-03: The README states whether the median pair difference is at most zero, which is the REQ-08 bound.

## Notes

- A run whose median pair difference exceeds zero is reported as a blocking finding against the per-issue view change, and is not fixed inside this measurement.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Measure validation views on this repository
